# Amir Beck

> Senior design engineer and product designer in San Francisco who both designs and ships fintech products. At Lumanu he leads the design of a B2B2C payments platform and personally builds it in React, Next.js, and TypeScript. He bridges Figma to production code on a design system that compounds.

## Facts

- Name: Amir Beck
- Role: Senior Design Engineer at Lumanu (February 2023 to present)
- Titles: design engineer, product designer
- Location: San Francisco, CA
- Focus: fintech and payments product design, design systems, design to code, AI assisted prototyping
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Next.js, HTML/CSS, Figma, design tokens, Code Connect, Figma MCP
- Education: UC Davis, B.A. Digital Media and B.A. Economics

## Selected work

- Lumanu (2023 to now): leads design of a B2B2C payments platform. Personally coded 90% of the app redesign. Pivoted company strategy from influencer marketing to payments.
- SkySlope (2020 to 2022): improved UX across DigiSign, Forms, and Breeze. Led Breeze from concept through launch. Cut digital signing mistakes by ~50%. 15% increase in cross product usage.
- Granate (2022 to 2023): led product design for a grief support app. ~25% drop in onboarding drop off, and a ~30% lift in weekly engagement.
- EasyPeady (2021): designed and launched a standalone real estate form app in one quarter. Later the groundwork for SkySlope Breeze.
